transformTemplates: {"releases": $map($filter(releases, function($r) { $contains($r.version, "openshift-client-linux-amd64-rhel9-") and $contains($r.version, ".tar.gz") }), function($r) { var line := $r.version; var digest := $substring(line, 0, 64); var filename := $substring(line, 66, $length(line)); var ver := $replace($replace(filename, "openshift-client-linux-amd64-rhel9-", ""), ".tar.gz", ""); { "version": ver, "digest": digest } })}

{"releases": $map($filter(releases, function($r) { $contains($r.version, "openshift-client-linux-arm64-rhel9-") and $contains($r.version, ".tar.gz") }), function($r) { var line := $r.version; var digest := $substring(line, 0, 64); var filename := $substring(line, 66, $length(line)); var ver := $replace($replace(filename, "openshift-client-linux-arm64-rhel9-", ""), ".tar.gz", ""); { "version": ver, "digest": digest } })}

packageRules.description: Auto-merge patch and minor updates (stable deps only)

Never update these — /v2 vs /v3 (yaml) and .v4 vs .v5 (json-patch) are distinct Go modules with different import paths, not version bumps of the same module. Scoping this to matchUpdateTypes: ["major"] has repeatedly failed to catch Renovate/Mintmaker mis-classifying these as major updates (see #284), so the exclusion is now unconditional. Both are indirect-only deps, so they will still move naturally when their real importer upgrades and go mod tidy runs.
